title: Dental PPO Plans Decision Table: Missing-Tooth Clause Credit on Reprocessed Initial-Wait Lines
content:
Decision table for the Dental PPO Plans: months credited toward the missing-tooth clause on a line reprocessed after a denial for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date (a reprocessed initial-wait line). The credit follows where the replaced tooth was lost. The months credited are added to the months of continuous enrollment, and so decide the patient share on such a line.

| Record shown | Clause credit |
|---|---|
| The service records of the person's earlier DHMO enrollment show an extraction of that tooth on the line's extraction date | The calendar months from the month that DHMO coverage took effect through the month it ended, both months counted |
| No such DHMO extraction is recorded, and the enrollment shows documented prior coverage months whose prior coverage end date is on or after the extraction date and no more than 63 calendar days before the coverage effective date | Those documented prior coverage months |
| Otherwise | None |

**Earlier DHMO enrollment.** The person's earlier DHMO enrollment is the person's own terminated enrollment in Cascade's Prepaid Dental HMO Plans, matched by name and date of birth, that ended on the day before the Dental PPO enrollment's coverage effective date (a move from the DHMO with no break in coverage). The person's DHMO services are read only from that enrollment's own service records, never from another enrollment of the same subscriber.

**Reading the second row.** Both parts of the date condition must hold: the documented coverage must still have been running on the extraction date (its end date on or after the extraction date), and it must have ended no more than 63 calendar days before the coverage effective date (the same 63-day figure on every Dental PPO plan).

### Cases (hypothetical, clause of 12 months)
| Facts | Clause credit | Months of continuous enrollment on the date of service | Months counted against the clause |
|---|---|---|---|
| DHMO enrollment from 1 June to 31 December; its service records show the extraction of the tooth on the extraction date; Dental PPO effective 1 January | 7 | 5 | 12 |
| No DHMO extraction; 9 documented months ending 20 days before the coverage effective date and after the extraction date | 9 | 2 | 11 |
| No DHMO extraction; documented coverage ended before the extraction date | None | 4 | 4 |
